headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger's test indicates no significant funnel plot asymmetry (p=0.4980). The distribution of studies appears symmetric, suggesting a lower risk of publication bias.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 11 studies yielded an effect size of 1.13 (95% CI: 0.99–1.29), indicating no statistically significant association between Vitamin A and prostate cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential positive relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by substantial heterogeneity (I² = 73.79%), reflecting considerable variability across studies.
